name: dev
description: Provides development workflows, PR-writing guidance, code-craft preferences, runtime verification, and the bare `dev` dispatcher for Grove-backed projects — routes `dev grove …` to grove, repo-defined `.dev/<branch>` executables, and everything else to `grove dev`; also mounts `crtr dev` as a transparent passthrough.

requires.grove: Install Grove, then run `grove setup` in the source repository.

spec/requirements.whenToUse: Derive testable EARS requirements from a finished, approved design — in isolation, from the rendered design text alone.
